design.name: Flag postings that pay less than an amount
design.description: Flags (or excludes) a posting whose stated pay tops out below your minimum. Postings that state no pay pass.

settings.label: Minimum pay
settings.help: A yearly amount; anything that isn't a digit is ignored.

settings.label: Exclude instead of flag
settings.help: Type exclude to rule such postings out; leave empty to flag them.

design.behavior: Keep only the digits of setting1 (min) and payMax (max). If either is empty or longer than 15 digits, pass. If max < min, answer flag (exclude when setting2, trimmed and lower-cased, is exclude) with the note: tops out at <max>, below <min>. Otherwise pass.
